description: FREE local input and safety check before purchase. Accepts UBL/CII XML or a base64 ZUGFeRD/Factur-X PDF with exactly one embedded invoice XML plus buyer country, expected amount/currency and a trusted payee IBAN. It checks format, limits and required context, but does not reveal the paid decision or query VIES/sanctions. Subject to daily abuse protection.

b2b.description: Whether the transaction is business-to-business; this declaration does not itself prove that the customer VAT ID is valid.

buyer_country.description: Buyer jurisdiction as a two-letter ISO country code, supplied from trusted buyer context.

document_base64.description: Base64-encoded ZUGFeRD/Factur-X PDF containing one invoice XML; ordinary or scanned PDFs are unsupported. Use instead of invoice_xml.

expected_amount.description: Expected invoice total as a decimal monetary string in the expected currency, supplied independently by the buyer.

expected_buyer_vat.description: Expected buyer VAT ID from trusted buyer records, if available.

expected_currency.description: Expected invoice currency as a three-letter ISO 4217 code such as EUR.

expected_supplier_name.description: Expected supplier legal name from trusted buyer records, if available.

expected_supplier_vat.description: Expected supplier VAT ID from trusted buyer records, if available; leave empty rather than inventing it.

filename.description: Document filename with the correct XML or PDF extension; this is not a local path to read or upload automatically.

invoice_xml.description: Complete UBL or CII invoice XML. Provide exactly one document input: invoice_xml or document_base64.

purchase_order_reference.description: Expected purchase-order reference to compare with the invoice, if the buyer has one.

supply_type.description: Declared supply category used for VAT treatment, normally service or goods; use the actual transaction type.

trusted_payee_iban.description: Payee IBAN from the buyer's independently trusted supplier records, not merely copied from the invoice being checked.

name: prepare_invoice_to_pay_eu

outputSchema.description: Structured result contract for prepare_invoice_to_pay_eu. A success satisfies the documented success branch. A domain or tool error includes error and is not a successful settlement; unpaid x402 requirements are carried by the transport wrapper.

charged.description: When present on an error, false means the failed result is uncharged.

price.description: No payment is required for this tool.

settled.description: When present on an error, false means no settlement occurred.
